summary: Word-boundary snapping for sub-sentence speaker assignment. Drag-select offsets now snap outward to whole-word boundaries so a range assignment never splits a word mid-character. Two mirrored pure helpers implement one algorithm (expand-outward, whitespace-run boundaries, trailing punctuation stays with its word); the backend is the authoritative enforcement point (INV-SNAP-1), the frontend is a UX preview twin. Consolidates and supersedes the two non-conforming task01/task02 queue entries.

changes.summary: NEW module-level _snap_offset_to_word_boundary(text, offset, boundary) (defined just before _split_segment_at_offset). _apply_range_assignment now snaps start_offset/end_offset against the relevant span's text at all four split sites (single-span start+end against text; cross-span end against end_text, start against start_text) BEFORE calling _split_segment_at_offset. _split_segment_at_offset itself unchanged (still a pure raw-offset splitter). PUT /chapters/{id}/script-view/assignments range_assignments path now snaps authoritatively regardless of caller (INV-SNAP-1). API shape unchanged; only split positions differ (never mid-word). Whole-span 'assignments' path untouched (INV-SNAP-4); losslessness preserved (INV-SNAP-3). TWIN: frontend snapOffsetToWordBoundary in ScriptView.tsx — keep in sync.

NEW exported pure helper snapOffsetToWordBoundary(text, offset, boundary). handleSelection() now snaps range.startOffset ('start') and range.endOffset ('end') against each endpoint's own span text (via existing spanMap) before setPendingSelection. start_span_id/end_span_id unchanged (INV-SNAP-2). UX preview only; backend enforces the real guarantee. Rendering-span nested-node / showSafeText edge case intentionally not handled here (tracked separately). TWIN: backend _snap_offset_to_word_boundary in app/domain/chapters/operations.py.

New backend test file (range_assignments/split path previously had zero coverage). 12 tests: unit-level snapping boundary cases (offset 0, offset len, whitespace boundary, mid-word start/end, trailing punctuation) and behavior-level assertions on final segment text_content after save_script_assignments (mid-word start/end snap, whitespace baseline, losslessness, cross-span both-ends, cross-span trailing punctuation). R1 revert-checked (helper neutered to passthrough -> 7 behavior tests red with mid-word splits like ['hello br','ave world'] -> restored green).

NEW describe('snapOffsetToWordBoundary') with 6 unit tests: offset 0, offset at length, whitespace boundary, offset inside a word (start/end), trailing punctuation ('Marcus,'). R1 revert-checked (6 red without the helper -> restored green).

invariants: INV-SNAP-1 backend snaps independently of frontend; INV-SNAP-2 only offsets move, span ids unchanged, in-range stays [0,len]; INV-SNAP-3 losslessness left+right==original; INV-SNAP-4 whole-span assignment path untouched. The two implementations MUST stay algorithmically identical (twin); each file comments the other.
note: Closes design-docs/plans/active/archive/span_word_boundary_snapping/ tasks 001+002 (003 already done). Separately-scoped resync-survival gap documented in design-docs/plans/proposals/span_resync_preservation.md, not fixed here.
